dummy.method: Four weighed steel ballast portions; continuous equivalent steel blocks model mass and all three moments. Fix at listed centres with foam/adhesive; include adhesive in weighed portion. No battery or electronics.
dummy.limitation: Match the actual built real dart before comparative tests; CAD targets depend on unmeasured stock and slicer mass. No passive nose-down or sticking claim.
